technicalNeeds.topic: Sole durable start owner and identity equivalence

technicalNeeds.topic: Three participant effects, marker evidence and cancellation fence
requirements: Consume existing payment participants/barriers/durable decision/order-commit contract by reference, not duplicate coordination config.
Bind phase evidence to exact resource/confirmation/txid lineage and actual subscription-specific markers with verified key/type.
Actual payment-succeeded acceptance requires investor debit, collection credit and order commit receipts plus retained principal conservation; order marker is insufficient.
Exercise empty cancel fence, duplicate phases, late Prepare, pre-effect rejection, compensation and interrupted commit forward recovery.

technicalNeeds.topic: Payment outcome and trusted reconciliation bridge
requirements: Map each contract result to retained FundOrder even before order Prepare/Commit; verify durable source/start identity, exact args and result evidence.
Authenticate machine-only delivery; txid, arbitrary String body or actor name is not a proof token.
Persist current versus final outcomes; identical final is safe, conflicting final rejects, recoverable-to-terminal needs authenticated durable reconciliation.
UNKNOWN/recovery observations authorize neither fresh debit, TA submission nor refund; stale observations cannot regress later terminal evidence.

technicalNeeds.topic: Forward TA and independent refund boundaries
requirements: Leave actual TA/holdings/refund execution to later slice while first UI can only truthfully show awaiting TA.
Reference sole existing simulator/financial configuration; no copied fixture, CNY/fee or second mock registry.
Later TA bridge authenticates successful payment and exact receipts/typed slots; old RecordTAShareConfirmation never receives cash orders.
Later independent refund uses only contract eligibility, original accounts/principal and authenticated outcome, never reservation release or unknown authorization.

technicalNeeds.topic: Runtime evidence projection, watermark and detail query
requirements: Consume actual event field/aggregate identity declarations; infer business meaning explicitly rather than nonexistent event.status.
Reducer maintains resource-scoped correlation, event identity dedupe, chronological/watermark provenance and separate request/payment/TA/refund evidence.
Replay/rebuild and transactional checkpoint must be exercised; old unknown cannot overwrite final confirmation/refund and early refusal remains observable without commit.
Owner-scoped query reports empty, stale, unavailable and unresolved correctly; no live available-balance or holdings-total claim from an unrelated read model.
Select an isolated owned consumer target and stack only in a later authorized package; nothing is generated now.
Generate typed domain/proto/query/component contracts where supported; manual auth, trusted mapping, codecs and bank adapters occupy explicit ports.
Reuse existing core plan/apply, merge/preflight, file ownership and one-to-many anchors; keep generated/manual dependency direction and do not overwrite shared apps.
Verify plugin capability/readiness rather than assuming a Fab fixture composition host is a generic bank implementation.
Synchronize case class/proto/converter/registration and exact serialized values under explicit version compatibility.
Persist source/start, intent/decision, participant receipts and bridge/projection checkpoints before acknowledgement at their actual owners.
Restart actual application/JVM at request, Prepare, durable commit, result delivery and projection boundaries without a second cash effect.
Do not treat declaration test, source lowering, simulator JSONL reopen or pipeline actor restart as complete financial/application recovery.

technicalNeeds.topic: Operational evidence, observability and owned deployment
requirements: Propose explicit application component registration/config/namespaces, admission/backpressure and host capabilities in an owned target; no service/build execution in I0.
Trace operation/order/source/start/resource/result correlation, event/projection watermarks and receipt/codec/version pins with authorized redaction.
Health/readiness distinguishes connected/proposed/unsupported; metrics include unresolved/recovery and projection lag without falsely labeling them final failure/success.
Publish measured per-layer receipts outside tree, with current source/tool stability, executed versus excluded boundaries and no independent audit/compliance claim.
